recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reintroduce the literal 2018 either/or sentence; future changes to Bundle fullUrl/version uniqueness should use a new work-group decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking to change the bdl-7 human sentence from "FullUrl must be unique in a bundle, or else entries with the same fullUrl must have different meta.versionId" to explicit "Either fullUrl must be unique in a bundle or else..." wording.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-17078 source commit was found. Jira records that the request became redundant because the language had been removed, while later git history shows bdl-7 continued to be refined by subsequent Bundle issues before the current combined branch replaced the old sentence.
additional_context: Bundle is an active current-build resource. Same-family Bundle decisions already represented on the combined branch control the current source: FHIR-17085 documents duplicate-version guidance, FHIR-18284 handles history delete/resource-absent cases, FHIR-39476 preserves missing meta.versionId behavior, and FHIR-31986 rewrote bdl-7 to the current entries-with-same-fullUrl wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The final combined-branch audit commit records that current source already satisfies FHIR-17078 because the obsolete target sentence has been removed by later, more precise bdl-7 work.

related_jiras.note: Already-audited Bundle duplicate-version guidance explains that one resource version appears once while multiple versions may appear.
Already-audited bdl-7 history exception explains why entries without resources must not fail the uniqueness invariant.
Already-published source fix rewrote bdl-7 and removed the old wording targeted by FHIR-17078.
Already-audited bdl-7 revision preserves the missing meta.versionId fallback used in the current invariant.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking bdl-7 wording to use explicit either/or language; Jira comment says the request became redundant because the language had been removed.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed request and supports a no-change result because current source no longer contains the targeted wording.

evidence_items.summary: Current bdl-7 says entries with the same fullUrl where resource is present must have different meta.versionId values.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative invariant no longer contains the ambiguous comma-separated sentence targeted by FHIR-17078.

evidence_items.summary: Current Bundle uniqueness narrative says each resource version appears once while multiple versions may appear, with ambiguity and batch/transaction notes.
evidence_items.learned: The narrative conveys the intended uniqueness/version rule without reintroducing the obsolete either/or sentence.

evidence_items.summary: Bundle is listed as an active resource and assigned to the infrastructure work group.
evidence_items.learned: The inspected Bundle StructureDefinition and notes are in current build scope.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-18284 later changed the then-authoritative bdl-7 spreadsheet to add a history exception while the old sentence still existed.
evidence_items.learned: Later bdl-7 decisions and refactors became the controlling context for interpreting the seed wording request.

evidence_items.summary: The combined-branch FHIR-31986 source fix replaced the old bdl-7 human sentence with the current entries-with-same-fullUrl wording.
evidence_items.learned: A later decided issue already removed the wording FHIR-17078 targeted, so no additional source change should be made for the seed.
